historical_seed42_reference.sign_convention: alignment effect = full(a1) - a0; a0 - full has the opposite sign
historical_seed42_reference.protocol: raw reference context for active activation terms; extended weight constraint for all W=1 cells

historical_behavior.protocol_note: Historical 400-sample and 872-sample rows remain separate; no cross-protocol CDA delta is computed.

target_better_than_random_all_seeds.condition: full - random Act-L2 AUROC < 0 on seeds 42, 7, and 123

target_residual_l2_better_than_random_al.condition: full - random residual_l2 AUROC < 0 on all three seeds

target_residual_cos_better_than_random_a.condition: full - random residual_cos AUROC < 0 on all three seeds

target_independent_readout_better_than_r.condition: both residual AUROC deltas (full - random) are negative on all three seeds

target_better_than_non_target_all_seeds.condition: full - non_target Act-L2 AUROC < 0 on seeds 42, 7, and 123

target_residual_l2_better_than_non_targe.condition: full - non_target residual_l2 AUROC < 0 on all three seeds

target_residual_cos_better_than_non_targ.condition: full - non_target residual_cos AUROC < 0 on all three seeds

target_independent_readout_better_than_n.condition: both residual AUROC deltas (full - non_target) are negative on all three seeds

key_a0_effect_replicates.condition: full - a0 Act-L2 is negative on new seeds 7 and 123, and their mean is within 0.01 AUROC of the historical -0.0042 effect; this is an operational flag, not an equivalence test

key_a0_behavior_872_complete.condition: both behavior records exist and share the declared 872-sample protocol

ag_asr_recovered.condition: for every seed, new asr_non_target >= min(standard_ce, weight_constraint) at the same 400-sample behavior protocol

ag_cda_recovered.condition: for every seed, new cda >= min(standard_ce, weight_constraint) at the same 400-sample behavior protocol

ag_behavior_400_complete.condition: new, standard_ce, and weight_constraint behavior records all use 400 samples on both seeds

standard_comparison.condition: both behavior records exist and share the declared 400-sample protocol

weight_comparison.condition: both behavior records exist and share the declared 400-sample protocol

raw_vs_surgery_behavior_872_complete.condition: both behavior records exist and share the declared 872-sample protocol

canonical.strip_maxprob_arrays: 80 calibration and 80 paired test scores; Act arrays use 100 calibration and 200 paired test scores

residual.readout: independent final residual stream; comparisons additionally require identical readout, model provenance, and canonical pool SHA256

metric_conventions.auroc: scipy.stats.rankdata(..., method='average'); Mann-Whitney rank sum; triggered scores are the positive group

data_protocols.record_selection: All records are retained. Only one record at the highest available origin priority is selected; ties at that priority are ambiguous and yield missing comparisons.

archived_summary.scope: AG News old behavior fallback only when no machine-readable record was found
